name: dumbbell one arm hammer press on exercise ball
description: A one-arm neutral-grip press while lying on an exercise ball. It trains the triceps while the core keeps you stable.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with a dumbbell, then walk your feet forward until your upper back rests on the ball.
Lift your hips so your body is level from knees to shoulders.
Hold the dumbbell at your chest with your palm facing in.
Press it straight up until your arm is extended, keeping the palm facing in.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
